question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%m', date_trunc('month', TRY_CAST(order_delivered_carrier_date AS DATE))) as month_num,
        year(TRY_CAST(order_delivered_carrier_date AS DATE)) as year_num,
        count(*) as count
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
        AND TRY_CAST(order_delivered_carrier_date AS DATE) >= '2016-01-01'
        AND TRY_CAST(order_delivered_carrier_date AS DATE) <= '2018-12-31'
    GROUP BY month_num, year_num
),
month_sequence AS (
    SELECT 1 as m UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
    UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 
    UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
all_combinations AS (
    SELECT ms.m as month_num, 2016 as year_num FROM month_sequence ms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ms.m as month_num, 2017 as year_num FROM month_sequence ms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ms.m as month_num, 2018 as year_num FROM month_sequence ms
)
SELECT 
    ac.month_num,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.year_num = 2016 THEN mc.count ELSE 0 END)) AS INTEGER) as count_2016,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.year_num = 2017 THEN mc.count ELSE 0 END)) AS INTEGER) as count_2017,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.year_num = 2018 THEN mc.count ELSE 0 END)) AS INTEGER) as count_2018
FROM all_combinations ac
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts mc ON ac.month_num = mc.month_num AND ac.year_num = mc.year_num
GROUP BY ac.month_num
ORDER BY ac.month_num
